rules.statement: A person who has entered into possession of land as a licensee is presumed to continue to possess it in the same capacity, and to claim prescriptive title, the licensee must prove an overt and unequivocal act manifesting his intention to possess adversely to the true owner.
rules.supporting_quote: Where a licensee claims that his original possession has later become adverse, he must prove of the manifestation of his intention to possess adversely to the true owner by what is sometimes referred to as an ‘overt unequivocal act’.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 3 of the Prescription Ordinance, No. 2 of 1889
